reviews.body: LGTM — candidates and thoughts are disjoint components of Gemini's total, so candidates + thoughts is the correct billed output figure at both usage sites, and the new tests encode the pre-fix undercount. CI is green. One note: the PR description appears to have been copied from a different codebase (GeminiRespToClaude / internal/transformer do not exist here); the commit message is accurate. Thanks!
